fusions.name: Crescent Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a wide arc 3 tiles ahead, dealing 14 damage to everything in it. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Last Cut
fusions.desc: Hurls you at an enemy at or below 25% health up to 6 tiles away, dealing 24 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Gathered Sheaf
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you, rising by 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Gleaning
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
